entry.title: Medicare's pilot GLP-1 discount program has a catch. Some sick patients don't qualify
entry.summary: Medicare launched a pilot program that could streamline the process to get GLP-1s, with some seniors paying just $50 a month. But many people with the most serious illnesses won't get that discount.

entry.title: The bridges of Rwanda open up new worlds
entry.summary: A charity built 96 bridges to connect communities separated by rivers and gorges. A new study looks at the life-changing impact of a concrete-and-steel pedestrian crossing.

entry.title: Pennsylvania measles deaths ignite clash over RFK Jr.'s vaccination claims
entry.summary: Two deaths associated with the measles outbreak in Pennsylvania prompted messaging from the health secretary that both encouraged and undermined vaccinations.

entry.title: Lights out, Instagram off? The changes to Meta for teens could be a big deal
entry.summary: Researchers and advocates are applauding the changes that Meta agreed to make for minors on Instagram and Facebook. Cutting kids off at night and during the school day are two big changes.

entry.title: The U.S. relied on these science advisers. Then the Trump administration cut them
entry.summary: The federal government recruits top experts to volunteer to advise on pressing research issues of the day. Since President Trump took office, hundreds of these experts have been dismissed.

entry.title: 4 ways to cope with constant thoughts about your body image
entry.summary: Obsessing over your looks should not take up all your energy, says psychologist Diana Hill. If you're struggling with uncomfortable thoughts about your body, ground yourself with these techniques.

entry.title: Rwandans love their milk bars. The health minister wishes they'd drink a little less
entry.summary: A big glass of moo juice — no, make that several glasses a day — is common in Rwanda. Is that too much of a good thing?

entry.title: Record cyclosporiasis outbreak and new food recalls raise concerns about food safety
entry.summary: Amid a record-setting outbreak of the diarrhea-causing parasite, food safety advocates say risks to food production are increasing.

entry.title: FDA approves landmark pancreatic cancer drug that's shown to improve survival
entry.summary: U.S. health officials have approved a groundbreaking pancreatic cancer drug that offers a new approach to treating the deadly form of cancer, by blocking a protein that fuels tumor growth in the vast majority of cases.

entry.title: Drugstores say Medicare's $50 obesity drug program is catching on
entry.summary: The Bridge program, which began July 1, makes some Medicare beneficiaries eligible for obesity drugs for $50 a month. CVS and Walgreens say they've each already filled 100,000 such prescriptions.
